lines.en: label nodokachristmalloween3:
scene clearnightskyupsidedown
Do you notice something wrong here?
lines.zh: 你注意到这里有什么不对劲吗？

lines.en: Because, at first, I didn’t.
lines.zh: 因为，一开始，我没有。

lines.en: And sometimes, I still don’t. I need to be {i}told{/i} I’m looking in the wrong direction or I’ll get lost out there in the ether — patiently waiting for someone to fish me out of an infinitely expanding void.
lines.zh: 而且有时候，我还是没有。得有人{i}告诉{/i}我我看错了方向，否则我就会在那片以太里迷路——耐心地等着谁把我从一片无限膨胀的虚空里捞出来。

lines.en: When I first met [[REDACTED], I was sixteen years old.
lines.zh: 我第一次见到 [已编辑] 的时候，十六岁。

lines.en: I was surprised to find out she was older than me given the height differential, but I quickly came around to the idea once I noticed how blasé she was.
lines.zh: 考虑到身高差，我惊讶地发现她比我大，但一注意到她是那么一副满不在乎的样子，我很快就接受了这个事实。

lines.en: Traits like that don’t come from nothing — they’re earned. Just like I earned my wings the first time I whipped out an off-the-cuff recitation of the Marriage of Heaven and Hell.
lines.zh: 那样的特质不是凭空来的——是挣来的。就像我第一次随口背出《天堂与地狱的婚姻》时，挣到了自己的翅膀。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome1
[[REDACTED] responded by telling me I was smart. But I struggle to tell the difference between intellect and memorization sometimes, so I can’t remember if I agreed with her or not.
lines.zh: [已编辑] 回应说我很聪明。但我有时候分不清智力和背诵，所以我不记得我当时同不同意她的说法。

lines.en: scene clearnightskyupsidedown

Regardless, I learned to fly that day. But it wasn’t long after that the wings I earned were clipped. And now all I can do is sit on my branch and think about the places I would travel to if only I could.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，那天我学会了飞。但没过多久，我挣来的翅膀就被剪掉了。如今我只能坐在自己的枝头上，想着要是还能飞，我会去哪些地方。

lines.en: “The hours of folly are measured by the clock,” huh?
lines.zh: 「愚昧的时光由时钟来计量」，是吧？

lines.en: I wonder what else that clock can measure? And if someone’s keeping track.
lines.zh: 我在想，那只钟还能计量些什么？以及有没有人在记录。

lines.en: They probably should. For time is a human construct and if clocks were to grow arms and start fighting for their independence, they could probably change our minds about that pretty easily.
lines.zh: 他们大概应该记。因为时间是人类的造物，而如果时钟长出胳膊、开始为独立而战，它们大概能轻而易举地改变我们对这件事的看法。

lines.en: But I digress — and I speak to you now from a disembodied plane of existence disguised as a journal.
lines.zh: 不过我扯远了——此刻我正从一个伪装成日记的、脱离肉体的存在层面向你说话。

lines.en: Captain’s log — tonight we’re playing truth or dare.
lines.zh: 舰长日志——今晚我们要玩真心话大冒险。

lines.en: I hope someone dares me to leave.
lines.zh: 真希望有人敢要我离开。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome2
: Well...{i}that{/i} was something.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}那{/i}可真够瞧的。

lines.en: : To think that all this time, you’d been seeing visions of her. No wonder you have so much pent-up sexual aggression.
lines.zh: : 想想看，原来你一直都能看见她的幻影。怪不得你憋了那么多性方面的攻击性。

lines.en: : I’m about to have a lot more now thanks to you. {i}Now{/i} she’s going to think she’s invited every time.
lines.zh: : 托你的福，我{i}现在{/i}要憋得更多了。这下她该觉得自己每次都受欢迎了。

lines.en: : Are you suggesting I should have ignored her and allowed you to continue hallucinating without any commentary or curiosity?
lines.zh: : 你是说我应该无视她，让你继续产生幻觉，不作任何评论、也不带任何好奇？

lines.en: : That was the implication, yes.
lines.zh: : 就是这个意思，对。

lines.en: : Well, then you should have said something. You know how I am when it comes to picking up social cues, Akira.
lines.zh: : 那你早该说啊。你知道我在接收社交信号这方面是什么德行，Akira。

lines.en: : And you know how I am when I’m not feeling right, so I’m sorry if I said anything back there that seemed a little rude.
lines.zh: : 而你也知道我不对劲的时候是什么德行，所以如果我刚才说了什么显得有点无礼的话，我道歉。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome3
: Oh, interesting. I didn’t think I’d be receiving an apology. Could karma exist after all? It seems only fair if gods do.
lines.zh: : 哦，有意思。我没想到会收到道歉。难道因果报应真的存在？如果众神存在，那倒也公平。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome4
: Speaking of that, you’re handling it a lot more casually than I would have expected given the amount of mental breakdowns I’ve seen you have over {i}world{/i} stuff.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，考虑到我见过你为{i}世界{/i}之类的事崩溃那么多次，你现在处理得比我预想的要淡定多了。

lines.en: : Those moments of enlightenment you bore witness to have less to do with the {i}world{/i} than you might expect. In fact, I’d go so far as to say they’re entirely self-motivated.
lines.zh: : 你目睹的那些顿悟时刻，跟{i}世界{/i}的关系比你以为的要小。事实上，我甚至可以说它们完全是出于自利的动机。

lines.en: : Oh? And do I get to find out what those motivations are now that you’ve ticked both time travel and the identity of my first love off your to-do list?
lines.zh: : 哦？既然你已经把时间旅行和我初恋的身份从待办清单上划掉了，那我是不是可以知道那些动机是什么了？

lines.en: : Perhaps. Though, I’m reluctant to give up my status as a member of the {i}incredibly{/i} exclusive club of girls who know more about {i}you{/i} than {i}you{/i} know about them.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。不过，我不太愿意放弃「比{i}你{/i}更了解{i}你{/i}」这个{i}极其{/i}排他的女孩俱乐部的会员身份。

lines.en: : Bet it feels nice, huh?
lines.zh: : 感觉挺爽的吧，嗯？

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome5
: Hard to say. I {i}did{/i} just have a threesome with a ghost. I’m not sure if anything will feel quite as good for a while.
lines.zh: : 难说。我刚跟一个鬼魂玩了三人行。我不确定短期内还会有什么能让我那么爽。

lines.en: : Just don’t tell Ami, okay? I don’t want her {i}trying{/i} anything.
lines.zh: : 别告诉 Ami，行吗？我可不想她去{i}尝试{/i}什么。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome6
: How do you know she doesn’t see her as well? It seems quite odd for her mother to only appear to {i}you{/i} when the two of you share that same trauma.
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道她看不见她？既然{i}你们{/i}两个共享同一段创伤，她妈妈只出现在你面前，这事儿也太奇怪了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, Ami was never sexually abused by her mother. So maybe that’s the key to being haunted?
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过 Ami 从没被她母亲性侵过。所以也许那才是被鬼缠上的关键？

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome7
: What a shame. That sounds like something I’d very much enjoy watching.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。那听起来像是我会非常乐意围观的事。

lines.en: : That’s not funny, Nodoka. Ami’s gone through enough as-is.
lines.zh: : 这一点都不好笑，Nodoka。Ami 已经受够多了。

lines.en: : Yes, I can imagine an eternal life of watching the man you love deflower everyone around you can be rather taxing on a girl.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我能想象，永生永世看着自己爱的男人夺走身边每一个人的贞操，对一个女孩来说确实相当折磨。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome8
: Yeah, well...Ami’s not aware that this {i}is{/i} an eternal life yet. I was talking about everything {i}else{/i} she’s had to go through.
lines.zh: : {i}是{/i}吗，不过……Ami 还不知道这是永生。我说的是她必须经历的{i}其他{/i}一切。

lines.en: : She’s really not aware? Why? Is that an intentional decision on your end? Or is there something about this place suppressing her from acquiring that knowledge?
lines.zh: : 她真的不知道？为什么？这是你有意为之，还是说这地方有什么东西压制了她获取那份知识？

lines.en: : You know, like what presumably happened with me before I managed to outsmart the world itself.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，就像我在成功智胜这个世界本身之前，大概经历过的事。

lines.en: : Talk to Ayane about it whenever she shows up again. She’s the one who talked to Ami earlier.
lines.zh: : 等 Ayane 下次出现的时候去问她吧。是她之前跟 Ami 谈过的。

lines.en: : You were suspicious of her then?
lines.zh: : 你当时就怀疑她了？

lines.en: : Something...like that.
lines.zh: : 算是……吧。

lines.en: : So, who {i}is{/i} involved then? Ayane? Maya? I’m almost certain Makoto is based on her outburst just before you showed up.
lines.zh: : 那都有谁牵扯进来了？Ayane？Maya？看你出现前她那番爆发，我几乎可以肯定有 Makoto。

lines.en: : Ayane, Makoto, and Yumi. Maya to a lesser extent. Then Tsuneyo to an even lesser extent than that.
lines.zh: : Ayane、Makoto，还有 Yumi。Maya 的程度轻一些。Tsuneyo 就更要轻得多了。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome9
: {i}Hah...{/i}Makoto is going to lord this over me, isn’t she? It’s the first time she’s ever truly beaten me at anything.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}Makoto 会拿这事儿在我面前耀武扬威的，对吧？这是她第一次在任何事情上真正赢了我。

lines.en: : I’d probably be a little more concerned about Yumi if I were you. She’s not exactly your biggest fan for reasons I’m sure you’re already aware of.
lines.zh: : 如果我是你，我大概会更担心 Yumi。她可算不上你的头号粉丝，原因我相信你心里有数。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome10
: Why would I be concerned about her when I have such a big, strong, reliable man to protect me?
lines.zh: : 我有这么一个高大、强壮、可靠的男人保护我，为什么要担心她？

lines.en: : Big, sure. Strong, maybe. Reliable? Are you sure the reset didn’t fuck with your memory at all?
lines.zh: : 高大，没错。强壮，也许吧。可靠？你确定重置没把你的记忆搞坏吗？

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome11
: You call what happened a “reset?” Why?
lines.zh: : 你把发生的事叫作「重置」？为什么？

lines.en: : Mostly because we’re thrown back to an earlier part in the school year where everyone loses the knowledge that any time has actually {i}passed{/i} at all.
lines.zh: : 主要是因为我们被扔回了学年更早的一个节点，所有人都会失去「时间真的{i}流逝{/i}过」的认知。

lines.en: : That’s why you’ll find so many people casually recollecting so many different Christmases in a single year of high school.
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么你会发现那么多人随口就能回忆起高中一年里那么多不同的圣诞节。

lines.en: : What is “Christmas?” Makoto mentioned that earlier too, but I have no recollection of it.
lines.zh: : 「圣诞节」是什么？Makoto 之前也提过，但我一点印象都没有。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome12
: Really? That’s...weird. Gaps in logic like that are normally filled in once you join the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那可……太怪了。像这样的逻辑缺口，通常是在你加入天台末日小队之后才会被填补上的。

lines.en: : Rooftop Apocalypse Squad?
lines.zh: : 天台末日小队？

lines.en: : It’s the name of our time-loop research team. We’re terrible and never get anything done. There are a lot of slumber parties, though.
lines.zh: : 我们时间循环研究小组的名字。我们很菜，什么事都干不成。不过睡衣派对倒是不少。

lines.en: : Fascinating.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome13
: But anyway, Christmas is a holiday that always comes on December 25th, where-
lines.zh: : 总之，圣诞节是一个永远在 12 月 25 日到来的节日，在那天——

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome14
scene nodokagoeshome15
: Did you seriously skip out on having sex with me to spread more anti-Christmalloween propaganda? Christmas isn’t real. No one believes you.
lines.zh: : 你该不会是特意撇下跟我做爱的机会，跑来散播更多反「圣诞万圣」的宣传吧？圣诞节根本不存在。没人信你。

lines.en: : Maya...you are here.
lines.zh: : Maya……你在这儿。

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 我在。

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Ah. That would be {i}my{/i} doing.
lines.zh: : 啊。那是{i}我{/i}干的。

lines.en: : I repeat. {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我再问一遍。{i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Because she is the one you really want tonight and I am but the bridge of magpies that connects the two of you.
lines.zh: : 因为她才是你今晚真正想要的人，而我不过是连接你们两个的那座鹊桥。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome16
: Nodoka sent me a text telling me to wait out here if I wanted to see you and I’m too desperate and sad and horny to ignore things like that anymore.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 给我发了短信，说如果我想见你就在这儿等着。而我现在又绝望又丧又饥渴，已经没办法再无视这种短信了。

lines.en: : Merry Christmalloween, Akira. I regret to inform you that I will be taking Maya’s side regarding your propaganda.
lines.zh: : 圣诞万圣快乐，Akira。我很遗憾地通知你，关于你的宣传，我要站在 Maya 那边。

lines.en: : So are the two of you just suddenly allies now that you’ve also been sucked into the universe’s bullshit or what?
lines.zh: : 所以你们两个现在突然成同盟了？就因为你也同样被卷进了这狗屁宇宙的破事里？

lines.en: : I don’t think so. If we were allies, I likely wouldn’t have let you ejaculate inside of me before delivering you to Maya.
lines.zh: : 我不这么认为。如果我们是同盟，我大概就不会在把你交给 Maya 之前让你射在我里面了。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome17
: Oh, good. Now I have to {i}wash{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。这下我还得把你{i}洗{/i}干净。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome18
: Anyway, goodnight. I had a lovely time and I hope you have more...{i}success{/i} with her than you did with me.
lines.zh: : 总之，晚安。我过得很愉快，希望你在她那儿比我更……{i}成功{/i}。

lines.en: : You don’t want to, like...ask her anything? Or corroborate information about the twisted reality you’ve suddenly become aware of?
lines.zh: : 你不想，比如说……问她点什么？或者核对一下你突然意识到的那个扭曲现实的信息？

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome19
: Wait — so you’re really a part of this too now? Does that mean we’re saved? Because your creepy genius powers or whatever they are can definitely get us out, right?
lines.zh: : 等等——所以你现在真的也掺和进来了？那是不是说明我们有救了？因为你那套诡异的天才能力什么的肯定能救我们出去，对吧？

lines.en: : That remains to be seen, but I wouldn’t get my hopes up. Thinking outside of the box is quite difficult to do when you can’t even figure out which direction you’re facing.
lines.zh: : 这还有待观察，但我不会抱太大希望。当你连自己面向哪个方向都搞不清的时候，跳出框框思考是相当困难的。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, uhh...thanks, I guess? This is my first time ordering a man.
lines.zh: : 哦。那，呃……谢了，我猜？这是我第一次订购一个男人。

lines.en: : Do I pay you? And, if so, do I get a discount on the basis of the product I received being damaged?
lines.zh: : 我要付钱吗？如果要的话，鉴于我收到的产品有瑕疵，能打个折吗？

lines.en: : No payment or even gratitude is required. What Akira wants is something I can not give him. And so I leave him in your hands hoping that you can absorb what I could not.
lines.zh: : 不需要付钱，也不需要感谢。Akira 想要的东西，是我给不了的。所以我把他交到你手上，希望你能吸收我吸收不了的东西。

lines.en: : Oh, I’ll absorb it alright. I already told Ami I’m going to be bruised and broken after tonight if all goes according to plan.
lines.zh: : 哦，我会吸收的，放心。我已经跟 Ami 说过了，如果一切按计划进行，今晚之后我会浑身淤青、支离破碎。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome20
: What? Why did you tell {i}her?{/i}
lines.zh: : 什么？你为什么要跟{i}她{/i}说？

lines.en: : So she wouldn’t fucking cock-block me again. I don’t want her showing up and hogging all the Sensei. I don’t care {i}how{/i} big you are.
lines.zh: : 这样她就不会他妈的再来搅我的好事了。我不想她冒出来独占全部的 Sensei。我才不管你有{i}多大{/i}。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome21
: Yeah, but now {i}I’m{/i} going to have to deal with whatever conversation or argument she’s drumming up as we speak. Couldn’t you just find someone to distract her?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可这下{i}我{/i}得去应付她此刻正在酝酿的某种对话或者争吵了。你就不能找个人去分散她的注意力吗？

lines.en: : The only person that’d be able to distract her is you. And if I had cloning powers, I can guarantee you we would not be having this conversation right now as I would be getting spit-roasted.
lines.zh: : 唯一能让她分心的人是你。如果我有克隆能力，我敢保证我们现在就不会站在这儿说这些了，因为我正被两头夹烤呢。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome22
: Either way, I-
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我——

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome23
: Wait, Nodoka — are you just leaving? You’re not even going to say bye?
lines.zh: : 等等，Nodoka——你就这么走了？连再见都不说？

lines.en: : I tried. But every second I spend here is one more that the two of you must sacrifice.
lines.zh: : 我试过了。但我在这里多待一秒，你们两个就要多牺牲一秒。

lines.en: : And even in a place like this, where such a resource never depletes, time is of the essence.
lines.zh: : 而且即使在这样一个资源永不枯竭的地方，时间也是至关重要的。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome24
Just TIME is of a lot of things, be it mice or men or malice. Which is why if all the clocks grow arms, I’ll drag them to my palace.
lines.zh: 只是 TIME（时间）是很多东西的关键，无论是老鼠、人类还是恶意。所以如果所有的钟都长出胳膊，我会把它们拖进我的宫殿。

lines.en: Remove their arms, remove their hands — I’m the queen of the dismembered. I’ll sign your letters with my blood//PS: return to sender.
lines.zh: 砍掉它们的胳膊，砍掉它们的双手——我是肢解之国的女王。我会用我的血签下你们的信//另：退回寄件人。

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome25
I no longer wish to live beneath what lives above me.
lines.zh: 我不再愿意活在那个凌驾于我之上的东西底下。

lines.en: For that high-up, forbidden realm of the unknowingly diseased has begun to seep through the ceiling/floor just to pool within the dome that encases both the light and several unfortunate bugs.
lines.zh: 因为那高高在上、禁忌的、属于浑然不觉的病患者的领域，已经开始从天花板／地板渗下来，只为积在那个同时罩住了光和几只倒霉虫子的穹顶里。

lines.en: I come to you now (LIVE) from the thirdmost speaker in the room with the most speakers in your house, whispering carefully so as to not disturb my father who isn’t.
lines.zh: 我此刻（直播中）从你家里那个音箱最多的房间里、第三靠边的那个音箱里向你说话，小心地压低声音，以免吵到我那位并不在家的父亲。

lines.en: I have sinned by introducing you to this world.
lines.zh: 我把你带进这个世界，是我的罪。

lines.en: And I would put you back into that tube if only these hands still worked.
lines.zh: 要是这双手还能动，我会把你塞回那根管子里。

lines.en: scene black
: ただいまー。
lines.zh: : ただいまー。 (我回来了～)

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome26
: I’m back a little earlier than expected.
lines.zh: : 我回来得比预计的早了点。

lines.en: : I made up with Futaba as well.
lines.zh: : 我也跟 Futaba 和好了。

lines.en: : Have you eaten yet?
lines.zh: : 你吃了吗？

lines.en: : No?
lines.zh: : 还没？

lines.en: : Then, would you like me to make you something?
lines.zh: : 那，要我做点什么给你吃吗？

lines.en: : You have to eat eventually.
lines.zh: : 你总得吃东西的。

lines.en: : A bath then?
lines.zh: : 那洗个澡呢？

lines.en: : Can you even hear me?
lines.zh: : 你听得见我说话吗？

lines.en: scene nodokagoeshome27
scene black
$ nodokachristmalloween3 = True
$ nodoka_love += 1
{i}Nodoka’s affection has increased to [nodoka_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Nodoka 的好感度提升到了 [nodoka_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump mayachristmalloween1
